text: i was painting the dead center of a very large face
resolution: The 'dead-center of a large face paints up-left' clarification confirmed the diagnosis: a coarse fixed paint grid over a finely-packed atlas made each cell straddle multiple face slots, so even a center click scattered onto a neighbour face. Fixed by making the atlas itself the fixed grid (textureize fitTexels → grid = packed atlas = one cell per padded texel in one slot, no bleed). Landed with the paint-grid rework (see req_1209). Code in HEAD (b3bef7ec8 + 2889db1d4), verified bundling + tests.
